system.description:
Starting at 6th level, your skill in combat keeps up with the more martial shinobi, and you won’t be left behind. You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

| #### Battle Medic / Fortitude Amp / Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d12. / Your unarmed and Taijutsu attacks gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This becomes +2 at 10th level. / Taijutsu you cast, of D-Rank or lower gain the Medical keyword. This becomes C-Rank at 6th and B-Rank at 10th level. / If you begin your turn with half or fewer hit points, you regain hit points equal to your Channeled Healing bonus. / Strength of 100 Enhancement / Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 2d12. / You gain a rank of Mastery with Strength based checks and Saves. / Constructs and Structures are Vulnerable to your [Unarmed Damage] / Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals [Unarmed Damage] you can push the target 10 feet in any direction, except upwards. / Strength of 1000 Enhancement / Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes 2d12. / You gain 2 ranks of Mastery with Strength based checks and Saves. / Constructs and Structures are Vulnerable to your [Unarmed Damage] / Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals [Unarmed Damage] you can push the target 10 feet in any direction, except upwards. / You gain DR (Damage reduction) vs all Damage, equal to your Channeled Healing bonus. |

When you score a critical hit with an Unarmed Attack, you can choose to instead deal [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage].

If you use Bladed Chakra Scalpel your unarmed damage becomes Piercing and if your attack result is 10 or more over the targets AC, they gain a rank of Bruised.
